newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador's economy grew 3.0 pct in first half.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador's economy grew 3.0 pct in first half.

text.p: El Salvador's economy grew by three percent in the first half of 1997 and inflation was 2.59, the president of the central bank, Roberto Orellana, said on Tuesday.
"It has been a good half, Macroeconomic stability has improved and the rhythm of growth has recovered," he said in a news conference.
The government said inflation in the first six months was 2.59 percent compared to the last half of 1996.
He said exports have risen as have international reserves.
